text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
ready for the second build-up run, please!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Filming while training. But it's not to check her form.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: This is also part of my self-producing strategy.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: "Let's clearly define our division of roles going forward."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I will handle the planning for your self-production for the time being.
I'll pass along the know-how as we go, too.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: "I'd like you to come up with a plan that balances my training with self-producing, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yes. First off, training takes top priority.
Entering races in peak condition—that's a baseline premise.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Just set up your normal training schedule,
and fit in your self-producing time during the gaps, you see.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Please take my physical condition into account and keep it reasonable.
In short, prioritize cost-performance and time-efficiency!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Health management is your area of expertise, isn't it, Trainer?
I'm counting on you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: If they're counting on my expertise and skill, then as a Trainer, I have to step up and deliver!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Balancing training and self-promotion.
Looking at time efficiency, the logical conclusion is to do both at the same time.
choice_data_list: Your arms are dropping! Watch your form!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "For now, we were filming training sessions like this and posting videos titled 'The Road to Debut' to work on gaining fans."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*... My pace in the second half
didn't quite reach the target, did it...?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"It's so frustrating...
What do I have to do to achieve it...?"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
Can we add even more basic training!?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
The way you called out to me today,
with that strict, no-nonsense tone, was great, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: That refusal to compromise is exactly what highlights my image as a hard worker.
choice_data_list: Won't pushing too hard look unnatural?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
If I want to build anticipation for my running,
this much is just about right.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: I want to grow my fanbase before my debut. Even if you run a great race, if there aren't enough eyes on you, the producing effect is weakened, wouldn't you say?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Any other questions?
Feel free to ask whatever's on your mind. I'll tell you anything!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much for reviewing the manuscript.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
You're welcome. Oh, right!
May I take a look at the page layout?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "In the cafeteria, Royce and Royce and Chrono Genesis are discussing something."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer-san.
I was just checking an article for the school newspaper.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: They told us they're putting together a 'Classmate Feature' for the Umamusume scheduled to debut this year.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Chrono-san is on the public relations committee, you know.
She has a deep understanding of racing history and writes such passionate columns for the school newspaper.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I-It's just a hobby of mine that got a bit out of hand...
I'm flattered, really...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
So, Chrono-san. About the page layout...
the arrangement's bugging me just a little bit...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Could you take a look at this matrix chart?
I wonder if I've paired up two people with similar types.
choice_data_list: (Ah! I got one of those too!)
(Ah! I got one of those too!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A set of matrix charts and ranking tables summarizing the traits of the Umamusume. I was given one too, as reference material for self-producing.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
! A-Amazing...!
The names of our entire generation are here...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Why don't we check it together
using this as a reference?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Taishin, let's all eat together!
There are three of them, perfectly enough for us! Come on, please?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"No way. Nobody willingly eats
bitter chewing gum."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Only one of them is bitter!
It's a test of luck, a test of luck!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll take it.
Why don't we try eating our tickets at the same time?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good!
Then Hayahide, let's take one each!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Indeed, delicious.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: B-B... IT'S SO BITTEEEEEER!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, well then,
I'll take some too.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: The contrast between the bright, cheerful Winning Ticket and the cool Narita Taishin.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: And like a dependable older sister mediator between the two, Biwa Hayahide-san.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I think it'd be best to put them into a trio.
Their personalities won't clash, and being together will make their individuality stand out even more.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes, those three share a very deep bond. Right after enrolling,
they competed against each other in class time trials,
which sparked quite a dramatic friendship...

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
For the mock live in the next class,
the stage positions are first come, first served!
We gotta hurry!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
Hohoho...
Everyone is so full of energy...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
"Haste makes waste..."
In other words, go steadily... so you don't stumble...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chitose O is a very calm and composed person.
Even the way she speaks is relaxed, like a sage.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"I'm a fast talker, so it's like a contrast of stillness and motion.
I think we complement each other quite well when paired together."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: I see...! In that case, with the pair of Yukino-san and Flight-san—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...Actually...
I had my doubts about the pairings as well...
But I lacked the confidence to convince anyone..."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I'll include your opinion when I present it to the Chairwoman...!
Thank you very much...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Royce and Royce pointed out the issues with the combination
out of pure kindness, but—
choice_data_list: Was there also an intent to self-produce?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, you noticed right away, didn't you?
You pass!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Hayahide-san and her group of three are the brightest prospects of this generation.
If I'm compared alongside them, I'll be completely overshadowed.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Then wouldn't the role of the shrewd contender aiming to take down the big three leave more of an impression?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Weekdays fly by in a flash with training and self-producing.
And on days off—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"The TV cameras are placed... just like usual.
Trainer, make sure you remember this spot."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
It's the best spot to make sure I'm on screen
whenever they show the winner's circle.
choice_data_list: You even kept track of where the TV cameras were!?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Of course! It's a precious opportunity to promote myself nationwide without lifting a finger!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: âAh, the race has started!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Keep pushiiiiing!!
Just a little more... to the goal!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"That final battle was amazing...!
My heart is still pounding!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: I'll finally be able to run on that turf soon too...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text: Oh, little lady, is your debut coming up soon?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yes! So I was hoping to learn from our upperclassmen
to ensure I can deliver a great run when it counts...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
“Still, when I realized it was my debut,
I just got so excited... That's no good, is it?”

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Nice, so fresh and full of hope!
I'll be cheering you on, too. Do your best!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Really? I'm so happy!
Royce will do her best!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: We need to leave a strong impression on racing fans as a rookie Umamusume full of promise.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
...With my current ability, the time will surely come
when I will taste bitter defeat.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Just imagine. An Umamusume full of hope
hits a wall... and her spirit shatters.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Thinking of your despair makes my heart feel like it's breaking!"
"Royce-chan! We're right here with you!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: —It's dramatic to the utmost degree, wouldn't you say?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I could only marvel at how far ahead she was planning.
It really drove home just how out of the ordinary her thinking was.
choice_data_list: (Still, I've gotta keep up with that...!)
(Still, I have to keep up with that...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As the Trainer supporting her, I must become someone capable of handling self-promotion as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even before her debut,
the challenges were already piling up—
